description: We are Friends of Mars, a team from Pakistan. We love space, Mars, and storytelling. For this challenge, we will create a beautiful and emotional story about NASA's discarded equipment left on the Moon and Mars. Our team is interested in writing, art, and space exploration. Everyone is welcome to join us!
summary: Our project tells the stories of the machines NASA left on the Moon and Mars, like Opportunity, Spirit, and InSight. We show what work they did and where they are now. Our goal is to turn forgotten machines into remembered heroes for school kids.
details:
Our project is Abandoned but Not Forgotten, by Friends of Mars.It tells the stories of the machines NASA left on the Moon and Mars, like Opportunity, Spirit, Sojourner, InSight, Voyager 1, and Apollo Lunar Modules.For each machine, we show what work it did and where it is now. For example, Opportunity searched for water on Mars, Spirit studied rocks, and InSight listened to Marsquakes.We made it as a simple presentation for school kids. We gave machines friendly names - Opportunity the Strong Friend, Spirit the Brave Friend, InSight the Listener Friend - so kids remember them easily.Benefit: Kids learn real space history in easy English.

Impact: To turn forgotten machines into remembered heroes and inspire kids to become scientists.

Tools: Google Slides / Canva for presentation, NASA websites for research.
